Former EVP of Merchandising William Boltz will transition to lead the Lowe's Foundation, focusing on the retailer's philanthropic efforts. Lowe's announced a partnership with Bilt Technologies to plug its products, loyalty rewards, and HomeCare+ subscriptions into Bilt's ecosystem of over 8 million members.
